broken.what: After 4 questions answered correctly, the home page still shows Dashboard 'Nothing secured yet — 0% across all subjects' and History 'No sessions yet'. The partial topic test is not saved, and there is no 'resume test' prompt.
broken.step: Student taps Home and leaves the test (17-after-leaving)

broken.what: The worked example for Q1 (280 g ÷ 35 cm³) has the same answer as the real question: 8 g/cm³. 'Different numbers, same method' gives the answer away, so the student can copy 8 without calculating.

Q5 has a step 3 asking for the mass in kg, but the question only says 'Calculate the mass of the liquid' with no unit. The kg conversion is only asked for in the worked example, so a mark depends on an unstated requirement.
On phone, the 'Read the worked example for this step' steps have no link to the example. It sits in a separate tab the student has to find, and they marked 'understood' without seeing it.

looks_wrong.what: The home 'Revise a topic' card lists 'Biology · Chemistry · Physics · Geography · Sociology' but not Maths, even though Maths topics exist.
After a correct answer the header replaces 'Topic test · question 1 of 10' with 'Good — keep going.', so the question count disappears.
Step 1 tells the student to 'Read the worked example for this step', but on phone the example is hidden behind the 'Worked example' tab with no link.

would_quit.quote: Use M = D × V to find the mass. (g)
would_quit.why: Fifth question and the first 3-mark one, with a third kg step the question never asked for. A bored student gives up rather than grind through it.

fixes.change: Use numbers that give a different answer, e.g. mass 300 g and volume 40 cm³, giving 7.5 g/cm³.
Either add 'Give your answer in kg' to the question or remove step 3, so the mark scheme matches what is asked.
Save progress after each step and show a 'Resume Ratio test – question 5 of 10' card on Home. Also log the in-progress session in History.

fixes.target: Home 'Revise a topic' card subject list
fixes.change: Add Maths to the subject list, e.g. 'Maths · Biology · Chemistry · Physics · Geography · Sociology'.
Add a 'Show worked example' button inside the step that switches to the tab. Also keep 'question N of 10' visible next to the 'Good — keep going.' message.
